params.label: Voicing
params.spec: Poly gives each note its own voice; mono plays one voice and restarts its envelope on every note; legato restarts only when no key is held (VO-6).

params.label: Polyphony
params.spec: How many notes can sound at once, in one pool (VO-5).

params.label: Gravity
params.spec: Held notes drift into just intervals of one another (SW-11).

params.label: Attack
params.spec: Time from a voice's start to full level.

params.label: Hold
params.spec: Time held at full level before the decay.

params.label: Decay
params.spec: Time from full level to the sustain level: the decay ends exactly then.

params.label: Sustain
params.spec: Level held while the key is down.

params.label: Release
params.spec: Time from key-up to silence: the release ends exactly then.

params.label: Attack curve
params.spec: Bends the attack: 0 straight, positive fast-start, negative slow-start (C.12). [Q31]

params.label: Decay curve
params.spec: Bends the decay (C.12); +2.30 is the bank's exponential. [Q31]

params.label: Release curve
params.spec: Bends the release (C.12). [Q31]

params.label: Velocity
params.spec: How much velocity scales the voice's level; at 1 level is proportional to velocity, at 0 velocity is ignored. This is velocity's default mapping (VO-8).

params.label: Osc 1 level
params.spec: osc 1's contribution to the voice.

params.label: Osc 2 level
params.spec: osc 2's contribution.

params.label: Sub level
params.spec: The sub's contribution.

params.label: Noise level
params.spec: The noise oscillator's contribution. Its bottom, v = 0, is a true off: gain exactly 0, not −60 dB (SN-4).

params.label: Level
params.spec: The engine's output level into the rest of the device; 0 dB is defined in 6.9; the ceiling lets a version-0 state keep its level (OU-3). [Q20]

params.label: Quality
params.spec: Oversampling: High aliases less on FM, ring and fold with sine carriers, at about 1.5 to 1.7 times the CPU. [Q27]

params.label: On
params.spec: The source's on switch (5.2): `osc1.on` (default on), `osc2.on` (off), `sub.on` (off), `noise.on` (off). A source that is off costs nothing (PF-6).

params.label: On
params.spec: The source's on switch (5.2): `osc1.on` (default on), `osc2.on` (off), `sub.on` (off), `noise.on` (off). A source that is off costs nothing (PF-6).

params.label: On
params.spec: The source's on switch (5.2): `osc1.on` (default on), `osc2.on` (off), `sub.on` (off), `noise.on` (off). A source that is off costs nothing (PF-6).

params.spec: The source's on switch (5.2): `osc1.on` (default on), `osc2.on` (off), `sub.on` (off), `noise.on` (off). A source that is off costs nothing (PF-6).

params.label: Octave
params.spec: Whole-octave transposition.

params.label: Semitone
params.spec: Whole-semitone transposition.

params.label: Coarse
params.spec: Continuous transposition that can be swept and automated across several octaves. The oscillator's transposition is octave + semitone/12 + pitch/12 octaves plus fine.

params.label: Fine
params.spec: Fine tuning.

params.label: Pan
params.spec: Shifts the whole oscillator's image left or right; members' seats shift with it and stop at the edges (C.8).

params.label: Mute
params.spec: Silences the oscillator; it keeps running (IF-6).

params.label: Solo
params.spec: While any source is soloed, only soloed sources sound (IF-6).

params.label: Unison
params.spec: How many members the swarm has.

params.label: Distribution
params.spec: How the members are placed around the pitch: evenly, on the classic supersaw curve, or shaped by a seeded draw (C.2).

params.label: Seed
params.spec: Fixes every random choice of this oscillator (placement, drift, start phases, spreads), so a patch is the same swarm every time. Shown under an advanced menu.

params.label: Detune law
params.spec: What detune means: equal cents (beats faster up the keyboard), equal Hz (the same beat everywhere), equal roughness (ERB), or members on harmonics of the pitch. [Q31]

params.label: Detune
params.spec: How far the members sit from the pitch (C.3): cents law, a member at placement x sits x·detune·range·100 c away; Hz law, x·detune·range·20 Hz; ERB law, x·detune·range·0.35·ERB(f); harmonic law, member i on f·(1 + detune·range·reach·i).

params.label: Range
params.spec: Widens detune to about an octave or two. [X11]

params.label: Harmonic reach
params.spec: Harmonic law only: how far up the series the members reach.

params.label: Root anchor
params.spec: 0 centres the swarm on the pitch; 1 puts its lowest member on the pitch. Advanced.

params.label: Coupling
params.spec: Positive pulls the members toward one locked pitch (cloud, herding, shimmer, lock); negative pushes them into an even splay (a multiplied, hollower tone). Feels the same at any detune (SW-4).

params.label: Phase lag
params.spec: Bends where a locked swarm settles; large angles open unstable, part-locked states.

params.label: Pivot
params.spec: Mean field locks onto the swarm's average; root member locks onto the member nearest the played pitch, so a locked swarm stays on pitch.

params.label: Onset lock
params.spec: A burst of locking (or, negative, of splay) at each note's start. [Q31]

params.label: Dissolve
params.spec: How long the onset burst takes to fade. [Q31]

params.label: Drift
params.spec: How far each member wanders in pitch.

params.label: Drift rate
params.spec: How fast they wander. [Q31]

params.label: Inertia
params.spec: Members swing into new places with weight and overshoot instead of jumping. [Q31]

params.label: Phase
params.spec: Where in its cycle every member starts when the oscillator retriggers.

params.label: Random
params.spec: How far each member's start is randomised past Phase: 0 all start together, 100 anywhere in the cycle.

params.label: Retrigger
params.spec: On: phases restart at each note (Phase and Random); off: they resume where the oscillator left off (SW-10).

params.label: Onset scatter
params.spec: Members enter up to this much apart, like players in an ensemble. [Q13, Q31]

params.label: Timing correction
params.spec: How strongly the entries correct toward the ensemble's average, so the swarm does not drift late.

params.label: Width
params.spec: How far the members spread across the stereo field; 0 is mono. [Q26]

params.label: Pan image
params.spec: Balanced places members so no side is brighter; the fans order them by pitch or by placement, a deliberate spectral-stereo effect.

params.label: Invert image
params.spec: Mirrors the image left for right. Advanced.

params.label: Pan motion
params.spec: Slow wandering of each member's pan.

params.label: Band-limit
params.spec: 1 removes the aliasing of every edge (ED-1); 0 leaves it, as a raw digital texture.

params.label: Motion grain
params.spec: How the spread law's values reach the blades: 1 in steps at the control rate (a grain and air in the sound), 0 as smooth ramps. The frame always ramps.

params.label: Base wave
params.range_text: sine, triangle, saw, reverse saw, square
params.spec: The wave the members play and the blades cut into.

params.label: Cross-mod
params.spec: Each member's previous output bends the next member's carrier phase (a ring of members).

params.label: Feedback
params.spec: Each member's own previous output bends its carrier phase.

params.label: Loop drive
params.spec: How hard cross-mod and feedback drive their loop: stable below about 0.5 with a saw carrier, 0.66 with a triangle and 0.75 with a sine, throughout with a reverse saw or square, and lower with sine→saw at low notes (0.24 at C1), chaotic above wherever the window is long enough, each setting its own noise (C.14, BL-12; round 20, ADR-244, corrected in round 22, ADR-248; the label is a placeholder until the naming workshop).

params.label: Spread law
params.spec: How every spread is fanned across the members (BL-13).

params.label: Spread drift
params.spec: Drift law only: how fast the spread values wander.

params.label: Quantize
params.spec: Whole snaps the cut-rate spreads and rules to whole harmonics.

params.label: Stacking
params.spec: Which blade is the upper one when they interact.

params.label: Upper hears
params.spec: 0: both blades act on the base wave side by side; 1: the upper blade acts on the lower blade's result.

params.label: Collision → pitch
params.spec: Where the blades overlap, the upper carrier's pitch bends up or down, up to ±2 octaves at full overlap.

params.label: Collision → bite
params.spec: Where the blades overlap, the upper blade's FM depth rises up to ×5 and its fold drive up to ×3 (C.11).

params.label: Envelope
params.spec: The envelope this oscillator's level follows (RC-6.5).

params.label: Pitch mode
params.spec: How Octave, Semitone, Coarse and Fine read; reserved for the 'harmonics' and 'ratio' modes after 1.0.

params.label: Stream
params.spec: Which notes this oscillator plays (RC-6.7): All, every note. Reserved until Arp's core lands, which appends the six other combinations of the Direct, Chord and Arp toggles after All, so v = 0 keeps its meaning (rounds 30, 31).

params.label: Blade
params.spec: Turns the blade on. [X12]

params.label: Mode
params.range_text: Sync, FM reset, FM free, Noise, Fold, Ring, Crush
params.spec: What replaces the wave inside the window (BL-2).

params.label: Blade wave
params.range_text: sine, triangle, saw, reverse saw, square, sine→saw
params.spec: The carrier's wave.

params.label: Shape
params.spec: Sine→saw only: from a sine (0) to a full saw (1).

params.label: Cut rate in
params.range_text: × pitch per cycle, × pitch per blade, Hz; blade 2 adds "as blade 1"
params.spec: Whether the cut rate follows the note (per cycle or per blade length) or is a fixed frequency (a formant).

params.label: Cut rate
params.spec: Carrier cycles per cycle of the member's wave (or per blade).

params.label: Cut rate
params.spec: The carrier's fixed frequency, when the cut rate is in Hz.

params.label: Position
params.spec: Where in the cycle the window sits.

params.label: Width
params.spec: How much of the cycle the window covers.

params.label: Edges
params.spec: Softens the window's edges; in Crush, the glide between steps.

params.label: Depth
params.spec: Blend from the base wave (0) to the blade's sound (1) inside the window.

params.label: Mirror
params.range_text: off, reflect, twin −, twin +; blade 2 adds "as blade 1"
params.spec: Reflect makes the window a palindrome; the twins add a second window half a cycle on, inverted (−) or not (+).

params.label: Frame
params.spec: Swarm frame places every member's window relative to the swarm's mean phase, so the windows move together as the swarm locks and drifts.

params.label: Rotate
params.spec: Moves the window around the cycle at this rate.

params.label: Rotation
params.range_text: blade 1: restart per note, free-running; blade 2: with blade 1, its own
params.spec: Whether each note starts the window at Position, and whether blade 2 turns with blade 1.

params.label: FM type
params.spec: FM modes: modulate the carrier's phase, or its pitch (symmetric in cents).

params.label: Mod shape
params.range_text: sine, triangle, saw, reverse saw, square, smooth noise, S&H noise
params.spec: The FM modulator's wave.

params.label: FM depth
params.spec: How hard the modulator pushes the carrier.

params.label: Mod rate in
params.spec: Whether the modulator follows the note or is fixed.

params.label: Mod rate
params.spec: Modulator frequency as a multiple of the member's pitch.

params.label: Mod rate
params.spec: Modulator frequency, fixed.

params.label: Position spread
params.spec: Fans the window's position across the members.

params.label: Cut spread
params.spec: Fans the cut rate across the members by s·p: up to ±s/2 harmonics at the outermost members (±0.75·s under the drift law), whole harmonics under Quantize; the effective cut never falls below 0.25 (C.9 item 8).

params.label: Cut rule
params.range_text: even, harmonic, undertone, octaves, major, minor, fifths, golden, primes, custom
params.spec: Gives each member's cut rate a ratio from a rule (BL-15).

params.label: Rule depth
params.spec: How far toward the rule's ratios the members go.

params.label: Width spread
params.spec: Fans the window width: w × 2^(4·spread·p), so up to ×4 either way (×8 under the drift law, whose p reaches ±0.75).

params.label: Depth spread
params.spec: Fans the depth.

params.label: Shape spread
params.spec: Fans the sine→saw shape.

params.label: FM index spread
params.spec: Fans the FM depth: index × 2^(4·spread·p), up to ×4 either way (×8 under the drift law).

params.label: Rotate spread
params.spec: Fans the rotation rate, so windows drift apart.

params.spec: Fans the cut rate across the members by s·p: up to ±s/2 harmonics at the outermost members (±0.75·s under the drift law), whole harmonics under Quantize; the effective cut never falls below 0.25 (C.9 item 8).

params.label: Cut rule

params.spec: Blade 2 uses blade 1's FM settings or its own.

params.label: Order
params.range_text: tone, env → drive; drive → tone, env
params.spec: Where the drive sits: after the tone and the envelope (the lab's order, the default), or ahead of them (SN-3).

params.label: Voice mode
params.spec: Per note: a sub in every voice. Mono: one sub for the instrument, at the chosen held note (SN-7). Per note is the default because it is the sound every patch had before (RC-9.2).

params.label: Mono follows
params.spec: Mono only: which held note the sub plays (SN-7).

params.label: Wave
params.range_text: sine, triangle, square, saw, pulse, bump, smooth square
params.spec: The sub's shape (SN-2). The smooth square is appended last, so it moves no index; the removal of the noise wave moved bump from index 6 to 5, harmless in a manifest not yet released. A panel may show the smooth square after the square. The round-25 noise wave is removed (the noise oscillator plays noise); the manifest is not yet released (5.1), so the option is removed, not retired.

params.label: Width
params.spec: Pulse only: the share of each cycle at +1; 0.5 is the square.

params.label: Softness
params.spec: Smooth square only: 1 is near a sine, 0 near a square (SN-2).

params.label: Harmonic A
params.spec: Bump only: which harmonic the first extra one is.

params.label: Amount A
params.spec: Bump only: the first extra harmonic's size (the round-25 bump's amount, same key and id).

params.label: Phase A
params.spec: Bump only: the first extra harmonic's phase; negative leads with the big bump (the round-25 bump's phase, same key and id).

params.label: Harmonic B
params.spec: Bump only: which harmonic the second extra one is.

params.label: Amount B
params.spec: Bump only: the second extra harmonic's size; 0 is the one-harmonic bump.

params.label: Phase B
params.spec: Bump only: the second extra harmonic's phase.

params.label: Octave
params.spec: A sub goes down only.

params.label: Coarse
params.spec: Continuous transposition, as the oscillators' Coarse (SN-1). A pitch envelope reaches the sub here: ENV 2 to ENV 4 route to it through the modulation system, like any destination.

params.label: Phase
params.spec: The sub's phase at a fresh start (SN-1).

params.label: Keytrack
params.spec: Off pins the sub to C2.

params.label: Erode
params.spec: The noise bends the sub's time, a noise-modulated delay; 0 is off and bit-identical (SN-14).

params.label: Drive
params.spec: Saturation of the shape (SN-5); 0 is clean.

params.label: Crunch
params.spec: A parallel, level-matched band of hard-clipped upper harmonics: grit without darkening (SN-5).

params.label: Character
params.spec: The saturation's curve: soft and asymmetric, a harder knee with a lower negative ceiling, or a gentle fold (SN-5).

params.label: Tone
params.spec: A gentle low-pass (SN-3).

params.label: Pan
params.spec: Places the sub in the stereo field (C.8).

params.label: Mute
params.spec: As the oscillators' (IF-6).

params.label: Solo
params.spec: As the oscillators' (IF-6).

params.label: Envelope
params.spec: The envelope the sub's level follows (RC-6.5; in mono, SN-7).

params.label: Pitch mode
params.spec: Reserved for the 'harmonics' and 'ratio' modes after 1.0.

params.label: Stream
params.spec: Which notes the sub plays (RC-6.7): All, every note. Reserved until Arp's core lands, which appends the six other combinations of the Direct, Chord and Arp toggles after All, so v = 0 keeps its meaning (rounds 30, 31).

params.label: Source
params.spec: What makes the noise (SN-8). Clean is the round-25 noise.

params.label: Density
params.spec: Crackle: pops per second.

params.label: Rate
params.spec: S&H: new values per second.

params.label: Length
params.spec: LFSR: the register's period; 63 steps or fewer repeat at the note's pitch, longer ones repeat below the note (127 about an octave down) and become hiss toward 32 767.

params.label: LFSR keytrack
params.spec: LFSR: off pins its clock to C3, as if every note were C3; Pitch still moves it (SN-8).

params.label: Colour
params.spec: +1 white, 0 pink, −1 brown, continuous between; on every source (SN-4).

params.label: Resonator
params.spec: A comb tuned to the note (SN-9).

params.label: Feedback
params.spec: Resonator: how long it rings.

params.label: Whisper
params.spec: Three vowel formants (SN-9).

params.label: Vowel
params.spec: Whisper: sweeps a–e–i–o–u.

params.label: Wind
params.spec: A band that wanders like wind (SN-9).

params.label: Gust
params.spec: Wind: how far and how fast the band wanders.

params.label: Filter
params.spec: The noise's own filter, ahead of the voice's filters (SN-10).

params.label: Cutoff
params.spec: The noise filter's cutoff.

params.label: Resonance
params.spec: The noise filter's resonance (Q 0.5 to 5).

params.label: Keytrack
params.spec: How far the cutoff follows the note: 1 fully, from C4; 0 not at all.

params.label: Pitch
params.spec: Transposes the noise's pitched parts: the LFSR's clock, the Resonator's tuning and the filter's keytracking (SN-11).

params.label: Stereo spread
params.spec: 0 is mono, as the round-25 noise; above 0 the two channels part (SN-12).

params.label: Pan
params.spec: Places the noise in the stereo field (C.8).

params.label: Mute
params.spec: As the oscillators' (IF-6).

params.label: Solo
params.spec: As the oscillators' (IF-6).

params.label: Envelope
params.spec: The envelope the noise's level follows (RC-6.5).

params.label: Pitch mode
params.spec: Reserved for the 'harmonics' and 'ratio' modes after 1.0.

params.label: Stream
params.spec: Which notes the noise plays (RC-6.7): All, every note. Reserved until Arp's core lands, which appends the six other combinations of the Direct, Chord and Arp toggles after All, so v = 0 keeps its meaning (rounds 30, 31).

params.label: Source mode
params.spec: Reserved for the sampler after 1.0, which appends `sample` (SN-13).

params.label: Loop
params.spec: Sampler: one-shot, or looping once it ships (SN-13).

params.label: Keytrack
params.spec: Sampler: pitched, or a fixed rate once it ships (SN-13).

params.label: Start
params.spec: Sampler: the start position (SN-13).

params.label: Random start
params.spec: Sampler: how far the start is randomised (SN-13).
